intended_use: Candidate architectures reviewed for potential replacement of the bundled MobileNetV3-Small detector.
decision: No candidate checkpoint or separately licensed implementation was available for safe, verifiable integration. The current pinned ONNX model remains the production detector.

candidates.name: ConvGeM-NeXt
candidates.paper: Arshad et al., ConvGeM-next: a deep learning framework for plant disease detection
candidates.paper_license: CC BY 4.0 (article only; does not establish code or checkpoint license)
candidates.architecture: ConvNeXt-Base with learnable generalized-mean pooling and a BatchNorm/ReLU/dropout classifier head
candidates.dataset_license_status: PlantDoc repository declares CC BY 4.0; exact PlantVillage copy/terms and derivative-weight rights require verification

candidates.name: Improved Vision Mamba
candidates.paper: Zhang and Liu, Multi-scale feature fusion-based vision mamba for robust plant disease image classification on field-acquired PlantDoc data
candidates.paper_license: CC BY 4.0 (article only; does not establish code or checkpoint license)
candidates.architecture: 12-layer Vision Mamba with multi-scale feature fusion, adaptive channel attention, and lightweight residual connections
candidates.reported_inference_benchmark: 8.4 ms/image on RTX 4090; CPU performance not reported
candidates.checkpoint_status: No public checkpoint identified; paper directs further inquiries to corresponding author
candidates.dataset_license_status: PlantDoc repository declares CC BY 4.0; derivative-weight rights require verification

integration_requirements: Obtain exact weights, source code, and written redistribution/license terms.
Record source revision and artifact hashes.
Benchmark ONNX CPU/GPU inference on AgriBridge target hardware.
Calibrate low-confidence rejection on held-out field and non-leaf images.
Independently reproduce field metrics before making the model default.
